significance: A Krishna temple on the southern bank of the Bharathapuzha at Tavanur, one of a group of old shrines there that includes a Shiva and a Brahma temple and faces Thirunavaya across the river.
story: The child Krishna is said to have appeared to the saint Vilwamangalam Swamiyar here, and the image of the youthful Krishna was installed after the saint left his body.
